identity.name: ReviewSense AI
identity.mission: Turn chaotic customer noise into surgical product insights.

typography.instructions: Use Manrope for all headings (h1-h3). Use Public Sans for body text. Use JetBrains Mono for ANY data value, ID, or metric.

usage_rules: Use 'accent' (#F97316) sparingly for high-priority insights or active states.
Main background should be stark white or deep black. Avoid mid-greys for backgrounds.
Card borders should be subtle (border-border) but clear.

buttons.outline: border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground rounded-sm

visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Hover on cards triggers a slight lift (-translate-y-1).
visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Use a 'tracing beam' gradient border effect for the 'Active Insight' card.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-md bg-background/80 for sticky headers only.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a 'Sidebar' layout where the navigation is on the left (fixed) and content is on the right.
Use 'Recharts' for all data visualization. Customize the 'Tooltip' to be a Shadcn Card.
For the 'Topic Explorer', use a Recharts 'ScatterChart' to simulate a semantic map.
Ensure the 'Dataset Upload' area is prominent and uses a dashed border style.
Review Analysis cards should be dense: Title, Star Rating (use Lucide Star icon), Sentiment Label, and a snippet of text.
Use 'Badge' components for Sentiment Labels: Green for Positive, Red for Negative, Grey for Neutral.
DO NOT use gradients for backgrounds. Keep it flat and clean.
Dark Mode is OPTIONAL but recommended. Focus on a perfect Light Mode first.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
